# Design point P009

## Description

Clients use GVFS transfer semantics to retrieve only the large-repository objects they need, reducing local data and metadata work. GVFS cache servers deployed alongside repository infrastructure, and near users and build machines, serve and accelerate this object traffic through co-located routing.
